================================================================================
cpath conditional argument tails retain nested and alternative branches
================================================================================
M(first
#if A
    , second, third
#if B
    , fourth
#endif
#elif C
    , fifth
#else
#endif
    , last);

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (global_statement
    (expression_statement
      (invocation_expression
        (identifier)
        (argument_list
          (argument
            (identifier))
          (preproc_if
            (identifier)
            (argument
              (identifier))
            (argument
              (identifier))
            (preproc_if
              (identifier)
              (argument
                (identifier)))
            (preproc_elif
              (identifier)
              (argument
                (identifier))
              (preproc_else)))
          (argument
            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
cpath conditional parameter tails retain nested and empty branches
================================================================================
class C {
    void M(int first
#if A
        , ref int second
#if B
        , int third = 3
#else
#endif
#elif C
        , int fourth = 4
#else
#endif
#if D
        , params int[] rest
#endif
    ) {}
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (class_declaration
    (identifier)
    (declaration_list
      (method_declaration
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list
          (parameter
            (predefined_type)
            (identifier))
          (preproc_if
            (identifier)
            (parameter
              (modifier)
              (predefined_type)
              (identifier))
            (preproc_if
              (identifier)
              (parameter
                (predefined_type)
                (identifier)
                (integer_literal))
              (preproc_else))
            (preproc_elif
              (identifier)
              (parameter
                (predefined_type)
                (identifier)
                (integer_literal))
              (preproc_else)))
          (preproc_if
            (identifier)
            (array_type
              (predefined_type)
              (array_rank_specifier))
            (identifier)))
        (block)))))

================================================================================
cpath conditional argument tail rejects missing comma
:error
================================================================================
M(first
#if A
    second
#endif
);

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit)

================================================================================
cpath conditional parameter tail rejects missing comma
:error
================================================================================
class C {
    void M(int first
#if A
        int second
#endif
    ) {}
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit)
